title: House Classic
notes: The reference 909 house groove - rolling acid bass, offbeat stabs, one sustained pad.

title: House Jackin
notes: Jackin' house - SP1200 hats against a 909 kick, offbeat 16th bassline.

title: House Lofi
notes: Dusty SP-1200 house in dorian - warm sub, two-note vamp, string wash.

title: House Linn
notes: Classic Linn-driven house, straight and bright, with a moving lead.

title: House Garage
notes: Garage-leaning swing feel with syncopated closed hats and organ-ish stabs.

title: House Hard
notes: Hard groove - heavy 808 kick, rolling 16th hats, aggressive acid.

title: Deep Warm
notes: Warm 808 deep house in dorian - soft sub, sparse vamp, long pad.

title: Deep Dusk
notes: Late-night deep house, kick and pad doing most of the work.

title: Deep Rhodes
notes: Rhodes-flavoured deep house - the electric piano carries the chords.

title: Deep Sub
notes: Sub-forward deep house - bass an octave down, everything else restrained.

title: Deep Shuffle
notes: Shuffled hat pattern against a straight kick - the swing is in the placement.

title: Deep Night
notes: The quietest of the deep set - one open hat a bar, everything floating.

title: Minimal Tick
notes: 606 minimal - lead deliberately silent, the bass and the space carry it.

title: Minimal Space
notes: Phrygian minimal - offbeat 16th hats, two blips a bar, no pad at all.

title: Minimal Clicks
notes: Click-track minimal - no open hat, tiny percussive lead accents.

title: Minimal Dry
notes: Dry and mechanical - the Fricke kit with almost no tail on anything.

title: Minimal Pulse
notes: Pure pulse - a 16th bassline and a steady eighth hat, nothing else moving.

title: Minimal Hypno
notes: Hypnotic phrygian loop - syncopated hats, a repeating two-note figure.

title: Dub Chord
notes: The dub techno essential - offbeat chord stab into long delay and reverb.

title: Dub Deepspace
notes: Pentatonic dub - sub bass two octaves down, everything drenched.

title: Dub Basic
notes: Berlin dub techno - steady 909, the stab is the whole arrangement.

title: Dub Halftime
notes: Half-time dub - two kicks a bar, the space between them is the point.

title: Dub Rimshot
notes: CR-78 and SCI toms - rimshot-led dub with a pentatonic stab.

title: Dub Echo
notes: DDM110 percussion dub - lighter kit, the echo doing the heavy lifting.

title: Trance Classic
notes: Classic trance - rolling 16ths, offbeat open hats, a melodic lead.

title: Trance Uplift
notes: Uplifting trance at 140 - wide lead line over a driving bass.

title: Trance Acid
notes: Acid trance in harmonic minor - the raised seventh does the tension.

title: Trance Rolling
notes: Rolling trance - Surge on the lead, DrumTraks giving it a harder edge.

title: Trance Dark
notes: Dark phrygian trance - heavy kick, brooding lead, no relief.

title: Trance Euphoric
notes: The only major-key preset in the set - euphoric trance, deliberately bright.

title: FX Tape Chorus
notes: Tape saturation into chorus - no reverb at all, width comes from the modulation.

title: FX Vinyl Room
notes: Vinyl crackle and wear into a small room - lo-fi house with dirt in front of the reverb.

title: FX Regrade
notes: Degrading delay into a thick chorus - the repeats fall apart as they widen.

title: FX EQ Aether
notes: Shaped with EQ before a large algorithmic reverb - the cleanest of the effect set.

title: FX Tape Hall
notes: Tape warmth into a full hall - deep house with everything softened.

title: FX Phase Room
notes: Slow stereo phasing into a small room - motion without any delay.

title: Echo Room
notes: GxEcho-Stereo into Roomy - a tighter room than the plate it started as; the pair it had was already taken by 075.

title: FX EQ Plate
notes: Three-band shaping into a classic plate - restrained and controllable.

title: FX Ringmod
notes: Ring modulation into a modulated delay - metallic and deliberately unmusical.

title: FX Autopan
notes: Auto-panning into early reflections only - movement across the stereo field, no tail.

title: FX Pingpong
notes: Hard ping-pong panning into a small room - the clicks bounce across the field.

title: FX Comp Delay
notes: Compressed hard, then a clean digital delay - tight and forward.

title: FX Taldub
notes: The dub delay proper into a huge reverb - the deepest tail in the set.

title: FX Dub Hall
notes: Dub delay into a concert hall - pentatonic and very slow to decay.

title: FX Dub Shimmer
notes: Tape echo into a shimmer reverb - the Berlin stab sent somewhere brighter.

title: FX Modulay
notes: Modulated delay into a plate - half-time dub with the repeats drifting in pitch.

title: FX Phase Hall
notes: Phaser sweep into a hall - classic trance width without a delay.

title: FX Chorus Aether
notes: Multivoice chorus into the largest reverb available - maximum lift.

title: FX Regrade Room
notes: Degrading repeats in a tight room - trance with the polish taken off.

title: FX Chorus Plate
notes: Chorus into a plate - the major-key euphoric preset, drier and more direct.

title: Dub Mutated
notes: Three Mutated Instruments voices at an exact 120 BPM - sub on the one and the and, the stab strictly offbeat, one sustained pad per bar feeding the dub delay. Tal-Dub-3 into Tal-Reverb-III.
